cristal-den/ghoulExpedition.title: Something in the Dark
cristal-den/ghoulExpedition.description: The ghouls roaming the desert near the capital ruins aren't just wandering, they're fleeing something. Whatever's chasing them out of the ruins needs to be found, and dealt with.
cristal-den/ghoulExpedition.desc-foundClues: You found information on the origins of the creature, called a Shadow Pony. They were created in the Umbridge Lab, from remains of King Sombra.
cristal-den/ghoulExpedition.desc-killedEntity: You destroyed the source of the corruption, ensuring that Shadow Ponies would never be made again.
cristal-den/ghoulExpedition.desc-solved: Whatever was driving the ghouls out of the capital ruins has been dealt with. The desert road should be a little safer for it.

bubbles.shadow-pony-line: Holy Celestia, what the buck is THAT?!

messages.expedition-completed: The expedition made it back to Cristal Den, you earned {{xp}} experience.
